## Release scope

Maris 0.2.4 fixes macOS native-capture buffering and topology-notification ordering, adds output-handoff diagnostics, and corrects retained DSP history after an outer signal-path change. It retains portable CLI/TUI packages for macOS, Linux and Windows on x86_64 and ARM64 through the existing exact-source native build, offline regression, package integrity and public installation gates.

## Changes

- Advance the DSP behavior revision to `music-fidelity-15`. An active outer gain, EQ, stereo or bypass change resets the incoming music-stage history while the existing whole-chain transition and limiter remain in place. Comparison-only changes and inactive bypass controls preserve valid history.
- Add five outer-chain regression cases for stale compressor and filter history, comparison compatibility, and bypassed controls. Native red/green evidence and the full PR checks are required before release.
- Preallocate the macOS system and mixer capture queues for 131,072 frames, twice the supported 65,536-frame callback bound. The previous 48,000-frame queues could discard part of a supported callback block before it reached the live source.
- Add regression coverage through the native capture callback and live-source processing paths, including a comparison that reproduces dropped frames with the former queue capacity.
- Publish the topology-change cause before advancing its configuration generation. This prevents a concurrent observer from acknowledging the first notification before its cause becomes visible; a concurrent callback-publication regression exercises this ordering.
- Add `status.coreaudio_handoff` with `snapshot_phase`, `replacement_armed`, `configuration_pending`, `output_callback_ready` and `watchdog_timeout_ms`, while preserving the existing flat status fields. `configuration_pending` is null when no tap is available. The timeout uses the same helper as the running guard.
- Mark live handoff snapshots as `live` and retained terminal snapshots as `before_teardown`. These software-state indicators do not prove that physical playback has recovered.
- Synchronize the Maris package and application metadata at version 0.2.4, with application build 6. Cargo.lock changes only the Maris package version; dependencies and the existing publication gates remain unchanged.

## Known limits and unfinished work

These packages are unsigned and have no publisher-signing or macOS notarization claim. Software and installation checks do not establish successful operation on a particular physical audio device or subjective sound quality.

- The previously reported Mac Pro no-sound symptom has not been confirmed resolved on the affected hardware. Its physical capture, routing and listening acceptance remains pending until the original Mac environment is reconnected.
- Original-audio muting/restoration, multiple-device clocks, device and power transitions, output loudness and subjective listening acceptance remain unverified on the affected setup.
- The separate GUI application acceptance and signing requirements remain open.
- CPAL/Flexaudio migration is not included. The locked dependency graph and its existing audit requirements are unchanged.
- Project licensing remains unspecified; this release does not add a license grant. Included third-party notices retain their own terms and provenance.

The generated changelog below describes committed software changes and does not replace the physical-device and listening acceptance above.
